headline: Gold prices cut by Tk3,266 per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has reduced gold prices across various carats, effective from August 7.
details: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has reduced the price of gold by Tk3,266 per bhori. The new prices became effective from 10:00 AM on Friday, August 7.
BAJUS stated that the price reduction is due to a decrease in the price of pure gold in the local market. The new rates include VAT.
According to the new price list, 22-carat gold is now priced at Tk2,29,664 per bhori. 21-carat gold is priced at Tk2,19,342, while 18-carat gold is Tk1,88,374 per bhori.
Gold priced by the traditional method is now Tk1,53,148 per bhori. Meanwhile, silver prices remain unchanged, with 22-carat silver at Tk4,899 per bhori.
This year, gold prices in the country have been adjusted 99 times, with 49 increases and 50 decreases. In 2025, prices were adjusted 93 times, including 64 increases and 29 decreases.
caption:
Gold prices in Bangladesh just dropped by Tk3,266 per bhori!

The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has reduced the price of gold by Tk3,266 per bhori. The new prices became effective from 10:00 AM on Friday, August 7.

BAJUS stated that the price reduction is due to a decrease in the price of pure gold in the local market. The new rates include VAT.

According to the new price list, 22-carat gold is now priced at Tk2,29,664 per bhori. 21-carat gold is priced at Tk2,19,342, while 18-carat gold is Tk1,88,374 per bhori.

Gold priced by the traditional method is now Tk1,53,148 per bhori. Meanwhile, silver prices remain unchanged, with 22-carat silver at Tk4,899 per bhori.

This year, gold prices in the country have been adjusted 99 times, with 49 increases and 50 decreases. In 2025, prices were adjusted 93 times, including 64 increases and 29 decreases.

headline_marked: 5 coaches of Dhaka-bound train [[derailed in Gafargaon]], suspending services
headline: 5 coaches of Dhaka-bound train derailed in Gafargaon, suspending services
summary: The incident occurred near Gafargaon Railway Station, leaving hundreds of passengers stranded as relief trains are deployed for recovery.
details: Five coaches, including a power car, of a Dhaka-bound commuter train from Jamalpur derailed near Gafargaon Railway Station in Mymensingh today.
The accident happened around 9:30 am on Friday (August 7) at the Shibganj Road level crossing.
According to Md Akhtar Hossain, officer-in-charge of Mymensingh Railway Police Station, no one was injured in the derailment.
However, the incident has caused significant disruption, suspending all train movement on the Dhaka-Mymensingh route.
Hundreds of passengers have been left stranded at various stations along the route due to the suspension.
A relief train from Mymensingh is currently heading to the site to recover the derailed coaches and clear the tracks.
